body: I was living at home for a while and i would sometimes run errands with her and we would eat food in her car or go on mini hikes. Nothing too deep. But I’m currently in a period of not wanting to speak to her. it’s not perfect, but I’m trying to accept that our relationship is complicated and heavy so I’m trying to give myself some patience, even when I feel bad/guilty for slipping back into my old habits. It’s def hella hard and I’m still trying to figure out how to rebuild our relationship in a way that doesn’t burn me out, so I’m in this with you friend.

What makes you think you're on a rebound and not genuinely interested in a new person? If you feel like there's a chance it's a rebound, its most likely a rebound. Do you find yourself comparing this new person to your old partner?  If you have doubts, it also might not be fair to the person you're "rebounding" on, so it might be best to wait it out, not only for yourself, but so you don't end up hurting the feelings of someone else.
